---
title: "Preparation of Survey Data"
format:
  html:
    include: false
    self-contained: true
---

```{r setup, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
```

## Import survey data

```{r import-survey-data, message = FALSE}
# Read and stack the three survey files
survey_sl  <- read_csv(here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2023_11_Bilendi", "Data_survey_sl12.csv"))
survey_fl  <- read_csv(here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2023_11_Bilendi", "Data_survey_fl.csv"))
survey_fl2 <- read_csv(here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2024_12_Dynata", "Data_survey_fl2.csv"))
online_survey <- rbind(survey_sl, survey_fl, survey_fl2)

# Lowercase session labels (raw data mixes e.g. "Indonesia" and "indonesia")
online_survey$session_label <- tolower(online_survey$session_label)
```

## Keep completed responses

```{r keep-completes, message = FALSE}
# Read and stack the lists of completed participants
complete_sl  <- read_csv(here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2023_11_Bilendi", "Completes_sl12.csv"))
complete_fl  <- read_csv(here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2023_11_Bilendi", "Completes_fl.csv"))
complete_fl2 <- read_csv(here("1_Data", "1_raw", "2024_12_Dynata", "Completes_fl2.csv"))
completes <- rbind(complete_sl, complete_fl, complete_fl2)

# Drop one complete that has no record in the survey data
completes <- filter(completes, participant_label != "FoOQRsEjNNlezhTpJJy4YA**")

# Keep only survey responses of completed participants
online_survey <- right_join(online_survey, select(completes, participant_label),
                            by = "participant_label")
```

## Recode variables

```{r recode-variables}
# Answer "more than 10" is stored as 99; recode to 11 (as stated in the SI)
online_survey$siblings[online_survey$siblings == 99] <- 11
online_survey$number_moves[online_survey$number_moves == 99] <- 11
online_survey$days_at_sea[online_survey$days_at_sea == 99] <- 11

# Replace numeric answer codes by labels
online_survey$gender <- factor(online_survey$gender,
                               levels = 1:5,
                               labels = c("male", "female", "non-binary", "n/a", "other"))

online_survey$ocean_health_importance <- factor(online_survey$ocean_health_importance,
                                                levels = 0:7,
                                                labels = c("no opinion",
                                                           "not important at all",
                                                           "not important",
                                                           "rather not important",
                                                           "undecided",
                                                           "rather important",
                                                           "important",
                                                           "very important"))
```

## Save processed data

```{r save-data}
write_csv(online_survey, here("1_Data", "2_processed", "Data_online_survey.csv"))
```
